limitations: This manifest is organization metadata, not a new raw receipt. It cannot independently authenticate original files or replace visual review.

Video captured_at is the runner's recording-ready observation, not the first frame timestamp. Duration/frame counts are original probe metadata, frame-timing review is recorded separately; continuous playback was not performed.
